<cap:headline>River Adhwara Group at Kamtaul in Darbhanga district of Bihar continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 pm today.</cap:headline>
<cap:description>River Adhwara Group at Kamtaul in Darbhanga district of Bihar continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 pm today. At 6:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 49.12 m with falling trend which is 0.12 m above its Warning Level of 49 m and 0.88 m below its Danger Level of 50 m.</cap:description>
